boards.title: Your First Weekend at University of Dallas, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure first-weekend loop through recognizable campus landmarks, student-life resources, and recurring ways to join in.

cards.title: Start at the Tower
cards.subtitle: A familiar campus meetup point
cards.notes: Use the Tower as a simple first landmark, then orient yourself toward the Mall and nearby campus buildings before choosing your next stop.
cards.short_summary: Begin with a recognizable meeting point and get your bearings.
cards.evidence_claim: UDallas identifies “Meet Us at the Tower” as a phrase students commonly use when meeting friends.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus landmark; follow posted campus-access guidance.

cards.title: Walk the Mall
cards.subtitle: Central campus corridor near the Tower
cards.notes: Take an unhurried pass along the Mall to connect the Tower, library buildings, and gathering spaces; use it to recognize routes before classes begin.
cards.short_summary: A daylight orientation walk through a central campus area.
cards.evidence_claim: The library’s Braniff and Blakley buildings are located on the Mall, north of the Tower.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor route; use the campus map and observe posted access rules.

cards.title: Find the Cowan-Blakley Library
cards.subtitle: Braniff and Blakley Buildings on the Mall
cards.notes: Locate the Braniff Foyer entrance and save the library as a dependable study-and-research stop for your first academic week.
cards.short_summary: Identify the campus library and its entrance before coursework begins.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cowan-Blakley Memorial Library is in the Braniff and Blakley Buildings, connected by an indoor walkway.
cards.access_notes: Public hours are listed as 8 a.m.–5 p.m. Monday–Friday, with calendar-dependent variations.

cards.title: Get oriented in Haggar
cards.subtitle: Student services and gathering spaces
cards.notes: Walk through Haggar to locate Student Activities and Student Life, then note the services you may need once the first week starts moving quickly.
cards.short_summary: Pinpoint practical student-life resources in one building.
cards.evidence_claim: UDallas lists Student Activities on Haggar’s main floor and Student Life on its second floor.
cards.access_notes: Office availability varies; check the relevant office before making a special trip.

cards.title: Pause at the Church of the Incarnation
cards.subtitle: Near the center of the Irving campus
cards.notes: If reflection or worship fits your weekend, step inside respectfully and check the church page for the current Mass, confession, and event schedule.
cards.short_summary: A central campus landmark for quiet reflection or worship.
cards.evidence_claim: The Church of the Incarnation serves the university community and welcomes students, staff, faculty, and neighbors.
cards.access_notes: Check the church’s current schedule before attending a service or event.

cards.title: Notice the Reliquary Chapel
cards.subtitle: Inside the Church of the Incarnation
cards.notes: While visiting the church, look for the St. Thomas Aquinas Reliquary Chapel and treat it as a quiet, respectful stop rather than a rushed photo break.
cards.short_summary: A distinctive sacred space within the campus church.
cards.evidence_claim: UDallas states that the Church of the Incarnation includes the St. Thomas Aquinas Reliquary Chapel.
cards.access_notes: Located within an active worship space; respect services and posted guidance.

cards.title: Sit on the Church Lawn
cards.subtitle: Outside the Church of the Incarnation
cards.notes: Bring a friend or a book for a short outdoor reset, using the lawn’s seating as a calm place to pause between your campus walk and evening plans.
cards.short_summary: A landscaped outdoor gathering and reflection area.
cards.evidence_claim: UDallas describes the renovated Church Lawn as a place for contemplation, conversation, prayer, outdoor classes, and quiet moments.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor space around the church; observe any event setup or posted restrictions.

cards.title: Locate the Maher Athletic Center
cards.subtitle: Home base for Crusader athletics
cards.notes: Find the athletic center now so you can recognize it on game days or when looking for campus fitness and recreation options later in the semester.
cards.short_summary: Get familiar with a major athletics and fitness destination.
cards.evidence_claim: UDallas identifies the Maher Athletic Center as housing its 15 men’s and women’s NCAA Division III varsity sports.
cards.access_notes: Athletic and fitness access may depend on student status, schedules, and facility policies.

cards.title: Catch Music on the Mall
cards.subtitle: Friday activity on the Mall
cards.notes: On a Friday, listen as students play music on the Mall; if you want to participate, use the university’s sign-up process for a DJ shift.
cards.short_summary: A recurring Friday music activity that makes the Mall feel lived-in.
cards.evidence_claim: CAB says students play music on the Mall every Friday from 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. and can sign up for DJ shifts.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists Fridays, 10 a.m.–5 p.m.; confirm programming for the particular academic-weekend date.

cards.title: Check out Rec Programming
cards.subtitle: Student-organized recreation and intramurals
cards.notes: Browse current recreation options and choose one low-stakes way to join in, such as a class, tournament, or intramural activity that fits your comfort level.
cards.short_summary: A practical route into student-organized recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: UDallas Rec Programming includes recreational classes, weekend and one-day tournaments, and intramural sports organized by students.
cards.access_notes: Participation is for current UD students, faculty, or staff and requires a Student Activities General Waiver before registration.
